title: REQ · UI store exposes drawer and modal state with toggleDrawer, openModal and closeModal
summary: Drawer open flag and modal state with their actions are available from useUiStore.
description: Context: no UI store exists. Desired behavior: useUiStore exposes drawerOpen (default false) and modal (default null, otherwise a ModalId such as 'contribution'), with toggleDrawer, openModal(id) and closeModal. Expected result: components can open the drawer and modals via the store. Why: mobile bottom drawer and the contribution modal need shared state.
acceptance_criteria: Given initial state, when read, then drawerOpen is false and modal is null
Given drawerOpen false, when toggleDrawer is called twice, then drawerOpen becomes true then false
Given modal null, when openModal('contribution') is called, then modal equals 'contribution'; when closeModal is called, then modal is null
definition_of_done: State and actions implemented and typed
